job_description:
Introduction
We are seeking highly skilled Senior Data Scientists to support mission-critical contracts with our Federal and DoD clients. We are building advanced systems leveraging technologies to solve complex national security challenges. We are also pioneering GenAI application development and test automation, and need innovative engineers ready to deliver secure, scalable solutions in a fast-paced environment.

Job Qualifications and Skills
The ideal candidate will possess several of the following skills:
• Development of New Machine Learning and AI Features/Products:
• Collaborate with teams to understand their unique situations, challenges, and opportunities. Utilize the knowledge gained to support the curation of potential new opportunities, leveraging AI/ML and Generative AI technologies.
• Take a hands-on, iterative approach in researching, designing, and building new machine learning and AI features/products
• Identify the most valuable models and methodologies, implement and train the models, and contribute to their deployment into the production environment.
• Maintenance and improvement of operational machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence implementations:
• Establish a detailed technical understanding of existing products that leverage AI/ML and Generative AI technologies – including the training datasets, model training methodologies, technical infrastructure, and model monitoring approach.
• Work collaboratively with product owner and architect to maintain a detailed roadmap for AI/ML epics, features, and stories – organizing the tangible work needed to maintain and improve upon our products.
• Monitor accuracy and precision of models over time.
• Lead efforts to retrain models by expanding upon underlying training datasets, introducing new features, and working with others to ensure training data is of the highest quality.

Requirements and Education / Certifications
• Ability to pass a National Agency Check with Inquiries (NACI) (required at time of hiring)
• At least six years of hands-on experience developing, deploying, and maintaining AI/ML products within a large, professional, or academic organization.
• Bachelor’s degree with specialization in a technology-related field (Computer Science preferred, Master’s preferred) from an accredited college or university, or equivalent combination of directly related education and/or experience.
• Advanced proficiency in coding and experience in Python and several other programming languages.
• Advanced knowledge and understanding in statistical modeling and data analysis techniques, platforms, and software.
• Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Advanced knowledge of AI/ML, NLP, and Generative AI technologies, frameworks, and solutions.
• Advanced knowledge of cloud data platforms, technologies, frameworks, and solutions.
• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Hands-on experience in designing, developing, and deploying AI/ML products into a cloud environment.
• Proficiency of existing and emerging trends within the AWS cloud environment
• Expert proficiency in Python data science development.
• Advanced experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques like Text Normalization, Named Entity Recognition, and Part-of-Speech (POS). Familiarity with more advanced techniques, such as word embeddings. Specific experience with popular AI/ML frameworks such as Transformer, Scikit-learn, SpaCy, XGBoost.
• S. Citizenship (due to contract requirements)
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, including working in cross-functional teams

About Us
We are is a mission-first technology company dedicated to serving private industry and federal agencies with cutting-edge software, cybersecurity, and cloud engineering solutions. For over 20 years, we’ve partnered with leading Fortune 500 companies and the U.S. government on programs that matter, from national defense to public safety. We bring together elite technologists, disciplined program managers, seasoned program analysts, and passionate innovators to help secure the nation’s most critical missions.

Join us if you want to work with purpose on problems that matter with a team that values agility, integrity, and impact.

job_description:
At ALSAC you do more than make a living; you make a difference.

We like people who are different…because we’re different, too. As one of the world’s most iconic and respected nonprofits, we know what it’s like to stand out. That’s why we’re looking at you. Your background, perspective, and desire to make an impact set you apart. As we work to help St. Jude cure childhood cancer, we're calling on the game-changers, innovators and visionaries to join our family. Not just for the kids of St. Jude, but also for you. Because at ALSAC, we develop and celebrate our employees. So, bring your whole, authentic self and become part of our shared mission: Finding cures. Saving children.®

Job Description

ALSAC is seeking a visionary Principal Data Scientist to lead the development and evolution of our Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) capabilities within a newly formed Marketing Analytics and Data Science team. This net-new role offers a unique opportunity to shape enterprise-wide measurement frameworks, drive strategic planning through scenario simulation, and pioneer AI-driven innovation in donor intelligence.

As a senior individual contributor, you will provide technical leadership, collaborate with external vendors in a build-operate-transfer model, and mentor junior data scientists. You’ll translate complex business questions into actionable analytical frameworks, ensuring modeling outputs are both rigorous and aligned with strategic goals.

Key Responsibilities
• MMM Capability Ownership Lead the design, validation, and continuous improvement of MMM solutions. Collaborate with vendors and internal teams to ensure scalable, accurate, and business-aligned models.
• Cross-Functional Partnership Work closely with marketing, finance, and media teams to align modeling efforts with business objectives and ensure insights are relevant and actionable.
• Model Quality & Innovation Champion data integrity, model validation, and methodological innovation. Stay ahead of industry trends in MMM, MTA, and causal inference.
• Testing & Experimentation Strategy Design robust testing frameworks to evaluate model reliability pre- and post-deployment.
• Integrated Measurement Strategy Support integration of MMM with other measurement approaches (e.g., MTA) to enable a unified view of marketing performance.
• Analytical Framework Development Translate complex business challenges into structured analytical approaches. Collaborate with analysts and stakeholders to ensure alignment with strategic goals.
• Mentorship & Best Practices Mentor junior team members, promote modeling standards, and foster a culture of excellence and continuous learning.

Top Skills & Experience

I. Advanced Modeling & Causal Inference
• Expertise in MTA, Bayesian modeling, Markov chains, SEM, and survival analysis.
• Skilled in causal inference techniques (DiD, synthetic control, BART).
• Ability to tailor models to varying data richness across channels.

II. Enterprise-Scale Forecasting & Simulation
• Experience building modular forecasting pipelines with elasticity-aware logic.
• Skilled in designing scenario simulators with constraints and real-time feedback.
• Familiarity with ensemble models, neural networks, and meta-modeling.

III. Strategic Insight & Stakeholder Engagement
• Proven ability to translate complex outputs into executive-ready insights.
• Experience presenting to senior leadership and crafting strategic narratives.
• Skilled in communicating uncertainty and scenario governance.

IV. Data Engineering Fluency
• Deep understanding of feature engineering, temporal alignment, and data lineage.
• Experience collaborating with ML engineers and MLOps teams.
• Proficient in working with structured/unstructured data across CRM, media, finance, and APIs.

Additional Impact Areas
• Enterprise-Wide Modeling: Extend MMM frameworks to include donor experience, bequests, and internal investments.
• Scenario Simulation Leadership: Co-lead the design of ALSAC’s What-If Scenario Simulator for strategic planning.
• AI & GenAI Innovation: Contribute to AI agent and GenAI tool development for donor intelligence and scenario planning.
• Governance & Transparency: Implement model governance, version control, and explainability tools (e.g., SHAP, LIME).
• Strategic Growth Path: This role evolves with ALSAC’s analytics maturity, offering long-term leadership opportunities.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or related quantitative field required.
• 10+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, or econometric modeling, with a focus on MMM.
• Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) strongly preferred.
• Demonstrated success in enterprise-scale modeling and strategic analytics leadership.

This role is going to be based out of our National Headquarters in Memphis Or in any of our 28 US-based territory offices.

Benefits & Perks

The following Benefits & Perks apply to Full-Time Roles Only.

We’re dedicated to ensuring children and their families have every opportunity to enjoy life’s special moments. We’re also committed to giving our staff excellent benefits so they can do the same.
• Core Medical Coverage: (low cost low deductible Medical, Dental, and Vison Insurance plans)
• 401K Retirement Plan with 7% Employer Contribution
• Exceptional Paid Time Off
• Maternity / Paternity Leave
• Infertility Treatment Program
• Adoption Assistance
• Education Assistance
• Enterprise Learning and Development
• And more

ALSAC is an equal employment opportunity employer.

ALSAC does not discriminate against any individual with regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, disability, veteran status, genetic information or other protected status.

No Search Firms

ALSAC does not accept unsolicited assistance from search firms for employment opportunities. All resumes submitted by search firms to any ALSAC employee or ALSAC representative via email, the internet or in any form and/or method without being contacted and approved by our Employee Experience team and without a valid written search agreement in place will result in no fee being paid if a referred candidate is hired by ALSAC.

By joining the American Red Cross you will touch millions of lives every year and experience the greatness of the human spirit at its best. Are you ready to be part of the world's largest humanitarian network?

Join us—Where your Career is a Force for Good!

Job Description:

The American Red Cross is hiring for two Data Scientists- Generative AI

WHY CHOOSE US?
Joining The American Red Cross is like nothing else – it’s as much something you feel as something you do. You become a vital part of the world’s largest humanitarian network. Joining a team of welcoming individuals who are exceptional, yet unassuming. Diverse, yet uncompromising in unity. You grow your career within a movement that matters, where success is measured in people helped, communities made whole, and individuals equipped to never stop changing lives and situations for the better.

When you choose to be a force for good, you’ll have mentors who empower your growth along a purposeful career path. You align your life’s work with an ongoing mission that’s bigger than all of us. As you care for others, you’re cared for with competitive compensation and benefits. You join a community that respects who you are away from work as much as what you do while at work.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW ABOUT THE JOB:
The Enterprise Data and Analytics (EDA) group supports almost every line of business at the American Red Cross. In the EDA Data Science group, we use Red Cross data to create modern, impact-focused data science products.

As a Data Scientist focused on generative AI in the EDA Data Sciences group, you’ll be responsible for supporting the organization’s generative AI needs within a highly complex data environment. You’ll provide business value through developing and maintaining new generative AI solutions, building generative AI workflows, working with infrastructure teams to implement those solutions in our cloud environments, and collaborating frequently with business stakeholders. You’ll apply specialized technical expertise to execute projects of high complexity, scope, size and/or risk that support business needs across the organization. The successful candidate will have a strong background in both generative AI development and off-the-shelf generative AI products. This position may serve as a lead on projects and will assist in identifying new business needs and providing training and guidance on generative AI topics to other staff.

The work location for this position is 100% virtual/work from home. While the position can be worked from anywhere in the United States, the preferred work hours are on an East Coast schedule.

WHERE YOUR CAREER IS A FORCE FOR GOOD (Key Responsibilities):
• Design, develop, and maintain generative AI solutions to support enterprise use cases.
• Collaborate with other data scientists, engineers, and product teams to integrate generative AI solutions into business applications.
• Monitor the performance of generative AI tools. Contribute to documentation, code reviews, and knowledge sharing with other Red Cross Data Science teams and stakeholders across the enterprise.
• Collaborate with the AI literacy team to provide generative AI training and guidance to other staff.

Scope: Individual contributor that works under limited supervision. Apply subject matter knowledge. Capacity to understand specific needs or requirements to apply skills/knowledge.

Note: Qualified candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. The American Red Cross does not sponsor employment visas.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED (required/minimum qualifications):
Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, quantitative social science, or a related field.

Experience: Minimum 5 years of related experience in machine learning or data science, with at least 1 year working directly on generative AI projects.

Skills & Abilities:
• Solid working knowledge of generative AI techniques and tools, with hands-on experience developing and deploying generative AI tools in production environments.
• The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical proficiency, a collaborative mindset, and the ability to translate complex AI concepts into practical business solutions.
• Expert-level proficiency in Python
• Solid understanding of transformer architectures, LLMs, and generative model training or fine-tuning
• Expertise in evaluating performance, security, and bias for generative AI tools
• Strong foundation in prompt engineering best practices, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and vector databases Ability to develop and troubleshoot analytics workflows within complex data ecosystems
• Proficiency with general database concepts and SQL
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to articulate analytical insights/complex findings in a clear and concise manner
• Experience using containers with continuous integration and deployment (CICD) technologies
• Experience working in an Agile environment preferred

-

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to handle or feel; and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 15 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. The work environment will consist of moderate noise (i.e. business office with computers, phones and printers, light traffic). The employee must have the ability to work in a small cubicle and have the ability to sit at a computer terminal for an extended period of time.

DISCLAIMER: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
PAY INFORMATION:
The annual salary range for this position is $115K - $125K. We do not offer an annual bonus for this role.

Note that American Red Cross salaries are aligned to the specific geographic location in which the work is primarily performed. Other factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have and comparison to other employees already in this role. **We will review specific salary information at the time of phone screening based upon your location & experience.**

This job will be posted for a minimum of five business days and extended if the applicant pool needs to be expanded.

BENEFITS FOR YOU:
As a mission-based organization, we believe our team needs great support to do great work. Our comprehensive package includes:
• Medical, Dental Vision plans
• Health Spending Accounts & Flexible Spending Accounts
• PTO: Starting at 19 days a year; based on type of job and tenure
• Holidays: 11 paid holidays comprised of six core holidays and five floating holidays
• 401K with up to 6% match
• Paid Family Leave
• Employee Assistance
• Disability and Insurance: Short + Long Term
• Service Awards and recognition
• LI-EH1

job_description:
Principal Associate, Data Scientist - US Card (New To Credit Team)

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

The New to Credit Data Science team develops machine learning models for marketing, risk, and valuation. We prioritize advanced modeling techniques, alternative data sources, and robust infrastructure to enhance decision accuracy and efficiency. You will collaborate with data scientists, business analysts, and software engineers on all stages of model development. This work will be conducted in a supportive environment that values your contributions, encourages new responsibilities, promotes ongoing learning, and rewards innovation.

In this role, you will:
• Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
• Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, Spark, Kubeflow Pipelines, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
• Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love
• Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

• A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

• Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms.
• Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers.

• A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 5 years of experience performing data analytics
• A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 3 years of experience performing data analytics
• A PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field)

Preferred Qualifications:
• Master’s Degree in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 3 years of industry experience in data science, or PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)
• At least 1 year of experience working with AWS
• At least 3 years’ experience in Python
• At least 3 years’ experience with building machine learning models, with at least one year of experience with building GBM models
• At least 3 years’ experience with SQL

Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Applied AI

Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

The Commercial Bank Data Science Applied AI team is at the forefront of enabling Generative AI capabilities within the Commercial Bank. We focus on cutting-edge techniques such as Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Context Engineering, Prompt Engineering, and LLM Fine Tuning. The ideal candidate will be deeply passionate about Generative AI and possess prior experience in AI from either a professional or academic background.

In this role, you will:
• Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love
• Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
• Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
• Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:
• Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.

job_description:
We are seeking an experienced and innovative Senior Data Scientist with a minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience to join our growing team. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on solving complex data problems, building machine learning solutions, and turning raw data into strategic insights. Are you passionate about advanced analytics, modern data architecture, and building scalable models? Do you enjoy working with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions? If so, this opportunity could be the next step in your career.

Primary Role: The Senior Data Scientist will lead the design and implementation of scalable machine learning models, data pipelines, and analytics solutions in support of large-scale data migration and integration projects. You will work with both structured and unstructured datasets using modern big data tools and cloud-based technologies to deliver insights and optimize performance across the organization.

How You Drive Value: Your ability to architect data workflows, build predictive models, and extract meaningful insights will play a key role in driving strategic decision-making. Your technical expertise will enhance our customers' capabilities in data processing, cloud analytics, and AI/ML innovation.

Travel: up to 10%

Candidates are required to reside within the National Capital Region. Working onsite, at the Coast Guard Headquarters up to 3 days a week.

You will:
• Collaborate with stakeholders, data architects, and engineers to understand business objectives and identify opportunities for data science solutions.
• Design and develop machine learning models and statistical algorithms that support predictive analytics and operational decision-making.
• Build and optimize ETL/ELT data pipelines using big data tools like Spark and Hadoop to process data at scale.
• Manage large datasets using modern data lake platforms such as Amazon S3, Databricks, and Snowflake.
• Extract, clean, and transform data from relational and non-relational sources including PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
• Develop automated workflows and integrate MLOps tools such as MLFlow for tracking, versioning, and deployment of models.
• Leverage Jupyter Notebooks for data exploration, analysis, and cross-team collaboration.
• Apply advanced deep learning techniques using frameworks such as FastAI to address complex problems.
• Program robust and efficient solutions using Python, R, SQL, Scala, or Java, and support additional scripting in languages such as Go or RUST when needed.
• Conduct statistical testing and hypothesis validation to uncover actionable insights and improve model accuracy.
• Create dynamic dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or Python visualization libraries to communicate findings effectively.
• Stay current with emerging tools, techniques, and trends in data science, cloud technologies, and machine learning.

You Have:
• Must be a United States Citizen.
• Must possess and maintain Department of Defense (DoD) Secret Level Security Clearance.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
• 5 years or more experience in data science, analytics, or a similar role with a strong record of delivering business impact through data.
• Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, SQL, Scala, or Java.
• Proven experience with big data frameworks and tools including Apache Spark, Hadoop, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.
• Hands-on experience with cloud-based data lake platforms such as Amazon S3, Databricks, and Snowflake.
• Familiarity with ML Flow, Jupyter Notebooks, and deep learning frameworks including Fast AI.
• Practical experience building, validating, and deploying machine learning models in production environments.
• Knowledge of scripting languages like Go or RUST for performance-critical applications.
• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Expertise in visualizing data insights using tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Python libraries such as Plotly and Matplotlib.

We Would Love it if You Had:
• Experience leading data science projects from inception through deployment.
• A strong understanding of ML Ops and automation pipelines for scalable ML delivery.
• Familiarity with model governance, performance monitoring, and optimization in live environments.
• Background working on data migration or enterprise-scale data integration efforts in the public or private sector.

This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to transformative data-driven initiatives while helping to modernize and secure data operations. If you have a passion for building intelligent systems and delivering real-world impact through data, we encourage you to apply.

Want to hear more? Read on to see what our Team Members say about their experience:

"Atlas Tech has the culture, trust, and fairness that you expect of the best of communities. I feel lucky to be part of their amazing journey of growth as a standout organization." - Syed
"You are not just a number here at Atlas. I have been with Atlas for over 13 years and I can say that Atlas displays a genuine interest in its employees. This is evidenced in its commitment to mentoring every employee and providing educational paths for each employee's personal and professional growth within the company." - Ian

Atlas Tech offers a competitive salary, generous benefits package, and an opportunity to make a positive impact in your own community.

job_description:
Are you passionate about working on a small, impactful team where your contributions directly influence mission success? Do you thrive on developing applications that leverage high-value data for critical insights? NS2 Mission is looking for a highly motivated, self-driven Data Scientist to join our team in Northern Virginia. Your work will involve creating innovative data solutions, enhancing workflows, and unlocking the potential of complex datasets.

This position involves a variety of responsibilities, including quality assurance of data feeds, providing support for data triage, and enhancing data collection and analysis workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong Python programming skills and a proven track record of working with both structured and unstructured data in various tools and platforms.

Key Responsibilities:
• Perform end-to-end quality assurance of data feeds and datasets.
• Support data triage and assessment activities.
• Identify and document opportunities to improve workflows and systems.
• Participate in regular stand-up meetings and provide input during code reviews.
• Cross-train on existing data collection tools.
• Build, monitor, and report on data systems (e.g., dashboards).
• Research and document options for collecting and aggregating data from various web and internal platforms.
• Evaluate web-based platforms for access control features and make recommendations for data acquisition.
• Develop and maintain Python-based scripts for data collection, processing, and system enhancement.
• Automate data cleanup, conditioning, management, and dissemination processes.
• Collaborate on new use case development and provide data-driven insights.

Required Skills and Experience:
• Strong experience programming in Python.
• Proficiency working with both structured and unstructured data (e.g., MS Excel).
• Experience with database tools (e.g., SQL, Presto) and data lakes (e.g., S3).
• Experience building data visualizations and dashboards with tools such as Elasticsearch, Kibana, Tableau, Apache Superset, or PowerBI.
• Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, easily understood reports, visuals, or presentations.
• Experience formulating analytic requirements, evaluating results, and communicating findings to stakeholders.
• Ability to work collaboratively, accept feedback, and develop customer-tailored data solutions.

Highly Desired Skills and Experience:
• Experience with AI/ML, particularly natural language processing in a production setting.
• Expertise in statistical modeling, hypothesis testing, and inferential statistics.
• Familiarity with data management tools like Hadoop, MapReduce, or similar.
• Hands-on experience with Apache Zeppelin, Jupyter Notebooks, and Spark/PySpark.
• Proficiency in MS Visual Basic for Applications (VBA).
• Background in supporting traditional and commercial targeting efforts.
• Programming experience in R.

Position Clearance Requirement:

TS/SCI with FSP

We win with inclusion

NS2 Mission’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At NS2 Mission, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

If you are interested in applying for employment with NS2 Mission and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: NS2Mission.Careers@sapns2.com.
